title: 第2章 癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一袭粉衣的梁音儿抬步跨了进来，对着夜弦劝道：

“夜师兄，我知道你对姐姐有愧，可若是要拿你的幸福去换姐姐好起来，姐姐她不会同意的！”

“你不能牺牲自己，去同和铃成亲，结为道侣！”

“夜师兄……”

梁音儿字字情真意切，一副为了夜弦考虑的样子。

青衣女子则是握着和铃的手劝道：“小师妹，你别犯傻，金丹对于修士来说意味着什么你不明白吗？”

“这是你的大道之基，是你将来能够养出元婴的先决条件！”

“我和师尊绝对不允许你把金丹挖出来送给夜弦！”

和铃想说两句什么，青衣女子直接对她下了禁言咒，控制住她，转头对着夜弦警告道：

“夜弦，你今日若是敢打我小师妹金丹的主意，我姜暮烟势必会让你知晓，我的紫烟剑到底有多利！”

夜弦唇角泛起一丝冷笑，“姜师姐。”

“这是和铃自己的事情，她的金丹，还轮不到师姐你来做主吧？”

“师姐一冲进来就否定她的决定，不觉得自己太强势了吗？难怪和铃一向和你们混元峰不亲热。”

夜弦语气嘲讽，带着一丝不耐。

“我强势？”姜暮烟这会儿是真气得七窍生烟了，怒极反笑，“夜弦，你个道貌岸然的贱人！”

“你明知道我小师妹喜欢你，从小就舍不得拒绝你任何要求，你还拿成亲这件事哄骗她，让她心甘情愿地把金丹送给你，你可真高明啊！”

“我们南华宗好歹也算是名门正派，行事端正，怎么养出你这么个混账东西！”

“挖人金丹你也做得出来？你修的什么道？”

梁音儿上前一步，挡在夜弦的前面，“姜师姐，你别这样骂夜师兄，你这样说他，真的很不公平。”

“夜师兄他从来没有逼迫过和铃师姐，是和铃师姐自愿救人的呀。”

“俗话说，救人一命胜造七级浮屠，如果不是因为我没有修成金丹境，拿不出一颗金丹来救姐姐，夜师兄也不会求到和铃师姐这儿来。”

“和铃师姐是大好人，她愿意救人是她的善心，不过俗话也说，强扭的瓜不甜，强求来的姻缘不长久，还望姜师姐能劝一劝和铃师姐，让她换一个条件，不要勉强夜师兄为了报恩娶她……”

姜暮烟一度怀疑自己的耳朵。

她听见了什么？

让她小师妹丢金丹又丢人，这么恶毒的话她还是头一回听见。

Liang Yin'er, dressed in pink clothes, stepped in and advised Ye Xian:

"Senior Brother Ye, I know you feel guilty about your sister, but if you want to trade your happiness for your sister to get better, she won't agree!"

"You can't sacrifice yourself to marry He Ling and become a Taoist couple!"

"Senior Brother Ye..."

Liang Yin'er spoke sincerely, as if she was thinking about Ye Xian.

The woman in green held He Ling's hand and persuaded: "Little junior sister, don't be stupid. Don't you understand what the golden elixir means to a monk?"

"This is the foundation of your great path and a prerequisite for you to be able to raise a Nascent Soul in the future!"

"Master and I will never allow you to dig out the golden elixir and give it to Ye Xian!"

He Ling wanted to say something, but the woman in green cast a mute spell on her, controlled her, turned to Ye Xian and warned:

"Yexian, if you dare to take advantage of my junior sister Jin Dan today, I, Jiang Muyan, will definitely let you know how powerful my Purple Smoke Sword is!"

A sneer appeared on Ye Xian's lips, "Senior Sister Jiang."

"This is He Ling's own business. Her golden elixir, it's not your turn to make the decision, senior sister, right?"

"Senior sister denied her decision as soon as she rushed in. Don't you think you are too strong? No wonder He Ling has never been affectionate with your Hunyuan Peak."

Ye Xian's tone was mocking, with a hint of impatience.

"Am I strong?" Jiang Muyan was so angry that she laughed angrily, "Yexian, you sanctimonious bitch!"

"You clearly know that my junior sister likes you, and you have been reluctant to refuse any of your requests since she was a child. You still used the idea of getting married to coax her into giving you the golden elixir willingly. You are so clever!"

"Our Nanhua Sect is a well-known and upright family and behaves properly. How could we raise such a bastard like you!"

"You can also dig out people's golden elixirs? What kind of Tao have you cultivated?"

Liang Yin'er took a step forward and stood in front of Ye Xian, "Senior Sister Jiang, don't scold Senior Brother Ye like this. It's really unfair for you to say this to him."

"Senior Brother Ye has never forced Senior Sister Heling. It was Senior Sister Heling who volunteered to save people."

"As the saying goes, saving one life is better than building a seven-level pagoda. If it weren't for the fact that I haven't cultivated to the golden elixir realm and can't bring out a golden elixir to save my sister, Senior Brother Ye wouldn't have come to Senior Sister Heling."

"Senior Sister Heling is a good person, and her willingness to save people is due to her kindness. However, as the saying goes, forceful melons are not sweet, and forced marriages will not last long. I hope Senior Sister Jiang can persuade Senior Sister Heling to change her conditions and not force Senior Brother Ye to marry her in order to repay his kindness..."

Jiang Muyan once doubted his ears.

What did she hear?

It was embarrassing for her junior sister to lose the golden elixir. This was the first time she heard such vicious words.
